integrity: Analytic proof of global injectivity and exact image, with 120 finite numerical corroborations; self-review passed; no independent validation or independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The global inverse theorem concerns a massless homogeneous unstressed plate on a known-density inviscid finite-depth fluid; it does not recover elastic modulus and thickness separately, provide finite-noise uncertainty or extend to ice inertia, precompression, attenuation or unknown currents.
title: Two-frequency recovery of depth and flexural rigidity from hydroelastic dispersion
